about_the_game:
Hanno: A Magical Tale is a visually captivating action-adventure game that blends fluid combat, story-driven exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

Set in the fictional world of Ashar, the player takes on the role of Vimal, an orphaned teenager from a small village who stumbles upon Hanno – an unusual baby elephant – alone and wounded in the forest. As Vimal, players must uncover the mystery behind Hanno, while battling malevolent creatures suddenly threatening his world.

An Elephantastic Bond

Experience the wonder of having a baby elephant companion: bond with Hanno and use his magical powers in combat and puzzle-solving.

The Askruras

Face fantastical foes, each with unique attack patterns and vulnerabilities - yet all united by a common goal - as you prepare for unexpected challenges in every battle.

Seize or save enemies and upgrade your skills across two paths.

Ashar

Explore the lush tropical regions, ancient forests and sacred temples of Ashar, filled with secrets and collectibles. Uncover a forgotten legend, for it holds the key to the truth.

Find items to customize Hanno.

The Boy and the Elephant

Immerse yourself in a heartfelt tale of growth, courage, and discovery – one that will stay with you long after it ends.

name: Hanno: A Magical Tale
short_description: An unusual baby elephant. An orphaned teenager. A threat to everything they hold dear. Brought together by fate, they will fight and explore as one, uncovering the true cost of loyalty in this stunning and heartfelt action-adventure.
